sections.lever checks:
- Family and target: h1 (notes/hooks.md), growth of the UFLPA Entity List from the version Doc 2 superseded to Doc 6's version. Medium target, hard welcome (no Easy slot, user 2026-10-09). Platform: no form check, quick test or difficulty result yet.
- Dependency plan: Doc 2 L77 (supersedes the November 1, 2024 list), L21 and L77-110 (five (ii) and twenty-five (v) additions), L160 (Daqo first listed June 2022), L164 (no removals), L165 (107). Doc 6 L76 (list as of August 3, 2026), L182 (187). Base 107 - (5 + 25 - 1) = 78; growth 187 - 78 = 109; 109 / 78 = 139.74%.
- Universe: the 30 named additions of the November 25, 2024 update, each checked by script against Doc 2's own (i), (ii) and (v) lists (2026-10-09): only Xinjiang Daqo New Energy also sits on another sub-list ((i), L177); the five (ii) additions are on no other list and the other 24 (v) additions are on no other list. Cross-check of the printed totals (doc-map shared ground): Doc 2's lists hold 9 + 39 + 72 = 120 placements and 13 repeat appearances (XPCC twice more; Baoding LYSZD, Hetian Haolin, Hetian Taida, Hoshine, Daqo, Junggar on (i) and (v); Hefei Bitland, two Lop County entries, No. 4 VSETC, Tengxiang on (ii) and (v)), 120 - 13 = 107 as printed. The same counting gives Doc 4's 144 (= 107 + 37, its 35 (v) additions including the already listed Aksu Huafu and Ashele Copper) and Doc 6's 187 (= 144 + 43), so the printed totals count each entity once and the November 1 version held 78.
- Necessity: Doc 2 is the only document that names the November 1, 2024 version or the November 2024 update (searched "November 1, 2024", "87391", "Western Gold", "Daqo"); Doc 4 starts from the November 25, 2024 list (L80) and Doc 6 from the January 15, 2025 list (L76), so without Doc 2 the base is unknowable from the bundle. Doc 6 is the only source of the August 3, 2026 count (Doc 4's 144 is the latest otherwise). Doc 4 is not needed (the route 187 - 78 skips it) and is not marked. Stated risk: the November 2024 update's size was public in 2024, so a solver without Doc 2 could reach 78 only by recalling it and, from Doc 4, that the November 25 list held 107 (144 less 37 new entities after spotting two already listed). The August 2026 count is post-cutoff, so no closed-book route reaches the gold.
- Selected-lever checks: Same series, right edition: the November 1 version is not printed anywhere; Doc 2's 107 belongs to November 25 (wrong route 74.8%). Who belongs where: Xinjiang Daqo is a (v) addition that was already on the (i) list (wrong route 142.9%). Calculate across documents: Doc 2's base with Doc 6's end count.
- Targeted failure modes: mode 1 (Look-alike measure, Takes the wrong line item): Doc 2 L21's sub-list additions (5 + 25 = 30) taken as entities new to the list: base 107 - 30 = 77, (187 - 77) / 77 = 142.857% -> 142.9%. Mode 2 (Wrong year or edition, Uses the wrong period or date): Doc 2 L165's 107 (as of November 25, 2024) taken as the November 1 count: (187 - 107) / 107 = 74.766% -> 74.8%. Considered and not declared: Doc 4's 144 taken as the latest count, (144 - 78) / 78 = 84.6%, which the question's August 3, 2026 date rules out on any reading; both slips together, (144 - 107) / 107 = 34.6%.
- Calculation verification: Python Fractions 2026-10-09: 107 - (5 + 25 - 1) = 78; 187 - 78 = 109; 109/78 = 1.3974358974... -> 139.74% -> 139.7% (one decimal). Wrong routes: 110/77 = 1.4285714 -> 142.9%; 80/107 = 0.7476636 -> 74.8%; 66/78 = 0.8461538 -> 84.6%; 37/107 = 0.3457944 -> 34.6%. No input rounding; the gold sits 0.04 from a rounding boundary, so no alternate input lands on it.
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: no document states a percentage or count change of the list, the November 1, 2024 count, or 109. The page overview gives Doc 2 "5 entities added to section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list · 25 entities added to section 2(d)(2)(B)(v) list" (the 30 route) and Doc 6 "43 new entities"; it states neither 107, 187 nor 78. Shortest valid route: find Doc 2's supersession of the November 1 version and its 107, back out the update's new entities (noticing Daqo), take Doc 6's 187, divide.
- Precision/readings: "UFLPA-listed entities" is the documents' "listed entities" (Doc 2 L61); "grow ... by what percentage" is relative change on the November 1 base; one decimal stated. Placements instead of entities would need sub-list counts no document prints and is not what "number of ... entities" means. On November 1, 2024 the version published that day was in force (Doc 2 supersedes it directly); on August 3, 2026, Doc 6's version "as of August 3, 2026".
- Completeness: full corpus, no gaps (notes/intake.json); D05's omitted Annex A graphics are irrelevant (no UFLPA content).
- Style/set review: 22 words, no em-dash. Sibling sketch i02 (entities listed when DOL published its H-2B NPRM, 78) shares the November 1 base and its Daqo step, so at most one of the two goes forward.
- Warnings answered: pending the floor.

sections.question: By what percentage, to one decimal place, did the number of UFLPA-listed entities grow from November 1, 2024 to August 3, 2026?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source fact (Doc 2, appendix 1): the November 2024 notice supersedes the UFLPA Entity List published in the Federal Register on November 1, 2024, so that version stayed in force until this update, and the list as of November 25, 2024 specifies "One hundred and seven entities" (107).

Step 2. Source fact (Doc 2, summary and appendix 1): the November 25, 2024 update adds five entities (5) to the section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list and twenty-five entities (25) to the section 2(d)(2)(B)(v) list, and no removals are made.

Step 3. Source fact (Doc 2, Xinjiang Daqo New Energy paragraph and the 2(d)(2)(B)(i) list): one of the twenty-five (v) additions, Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co., Ltd., "was first listed on the UFLPA Entity List, pursuant to Section 2(d)(2)(B)(i), in June 2022" and still appears on the (i) list, so it was already on the November 1, 2024 version. None of the other additions appears on another sub-list.

Step 4. Calculation (Doc 2 and Doc 6): sub-list additions in the November 25, 2024 update: 5 + 25 = 30.

Step 5. Calculation (Doc 2 and Doc 6): entities new to the list in that update, leaving out Xinjiang Daqo: 30 - 1 = 29.

Step 6. Calculation (Doc 2 and Doc 6): entities on the November 1, 2024 version: 107 - 29 = 78.

Step 7. Source fact (Doc 6, appendix 1): the UFLPA Entity List as of August 3, 2026 specifies "One hundred and eighty-seven entities" (187).

Step 8. Calculation (Doc 2 and Doc 6): growth in listed entities from November 1, 2024 to August 3, 2026: 187 - 78 = 109.

Step 9. Calculation (Doc 2 and Doc 6): growth as a share of the November 1, 2024 count, converted to percent and rounded to one decimal place: 109 / 78 = 139.7%.
sections.targeted failure modes:
### Failure mode 1
Trap: Look-alike measure
How a careless solver fails: Takes the wrong line item

### Failure mode 2
Trap: Wrong year or edition
How a careless solver fails: Uses the wrong period or date

Why these are traps: Look-alike measure: Doc 2's five plus twenty-five sub-list additions include Xinjiang Daqo, listed since June 2022, so only 29 entities were new; counting 30 gives a 77 base and 142.9%. Wrong edition: Doc 2's 107 is the November 25 count, not November 1; as the base it gives 74.8%.
